mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_auth (user_email, auth_code, expire_time, created_at) VALUES (#{userEmail}, #{authCode}, #{expireTime}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_email) DO UPDATE SET auth_code = EXCLUDED.auth_code, expire_time = EXCLUDED.expire_time, created_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT user_email AS userEmail, auth_code AS authCode, expire_time AS expireTime, created_at AS createdAt FROM email_auth WHERE user_email = #{userEmail}
